name: Hollow Shrine-Mask
loreTies: A mask that learned enough shrine etiquette to lure Kami guardians into the wrong ritual path.
Repositions around shrine terrain and causes missed timing windows.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Shrine-Mask is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into major battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Shrine-Mask formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Repositions around shrine terrain and causes missed timing windows. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A mask that learned enough shrine etiquette to lure Kami guardians into the wrong ritual path.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Shrine-Mask can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Shrine-Mask visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses floating lacquer mask cracked open with smoke hands, torn paper wards, ink bleeding upward. while its abilities — False Rite, Spirit Misstep, Mask Blink — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
